clauses: Report the signed difference: share minus the average share, so values can be negative.
Report the absolute difference between the share and the average share, so values are never negative.
readings: For each time-in-force value (`orders.timespan`), looking at risk/margin records matched to their order (`riskandmargin.ordervault` = `orders.recordvault`; unmatched records dropped), show the time in force, the number of distinct orders with risk/margin records (an order with several records counts once), that number's share of the total across all time-in-force values, and how much the share differs from the average share across the time-in-force values. Don't round. Report the signed difference: share minus the average share, so values can be negative.

For each time-in-force value (`orders.timespan`), looking at risk/margin records matched to their order (`riskandmargin.ordervault` = `orders.recordvault`; unmatched records dropped), show the time in force, the number of distinct orders with risk/margin records (an order with several records counts once), that number's share of the total across all time-in-force values, and how much the share differs from the average share across the time-in-force values. Don't round. Report the absolute difference between the share and the average share, so values are never negative.
queries:
SELECT
  o.timespan AS time_in_force,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault)) OVER () AS share,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault)) OVER () - AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault)) OVER ()) OVER () AS share_diff_from_avg
FROM riskandmargin r
JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
GROUP BY o.timespan;
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
shares AS (
  SELECT timespan, order_count,
         order_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT timespan,
       order_count,
       share,
       ABS(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS share_diff_from_avg
FROM shares;
